name: No Dashii
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.
interaction: Points at a player, who dies. Its nearest Townsfolk in each direction are poisoned passively (no wake needed).
drunk_or_poisoned: The kill fails and the Townsfolk neighbours are healthy while the No Dashii is drunk or poisoned.

rulings.text: The poisoned players are the nearest Townsfolk clockwise and anticlockwise, alive or dead; Outsiders, Minions and Travellers are skipped.
If a neighbour stops being a Townsfolk or characters change, the poison moves immediately to the new nearest Townsfolk.
If the No Dashii dies or loses its ability, both neighbours become healthy.

test_scenarios.name: adjacent neighbours poisoned
test_scenarios.setup: Clockwise seats: Alice No Dashii, Bob Town Crier, Carol Clockmaker, Dave Witch, Eve Snake Charmer
test_scenarios.expected: Bob and Eve are poisoned; Carol is not.

test_scenarios.name: skips non-Townsfolk
test_scenarios.setup: Clockwise: Alice No Dashii, Bob Witch, Carol Mutant, Dave Seamstress, Eve Philosopher
test_scenarios.expected: Dave and Eve are poisoned; Bob and Carol are skipped.

test_scenarios.name: dead neighbour stays poisoned
test_scenarios.setup: Clockwise: Alice No Dashii, Bob Town Crier, Carol Clockmaker, Dave Sage, Eve Snake Charmer
test_scenarios.expected: Bob dies but remains the poisoned neighbour; Carol stays healthy.

test_scenarios.name: night kill
test_scenarios.setup: Alice No Dashii, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dave Poisoner, Eve Monk

test_scenarios.name: death clears poison
test_scenarios.setup: Clockwise: Alice No Dashii, Bob Empath, Carol Chef, Dave Witch, Eve Savant, Frank Mutant
test_scenarios.expected: Alice dies, good wins; Bob and Eve are no longer poisoned.
